summary: MiMo-V2 router logits stay FP32 and the DFlash drafter applies its value scale
details: Backport of vllm-project/vllm#57784 (Zyann7): MiMo's BF16 gate weights produce FP32 router logits, as in the model's reference code, so near-tie expert choices no longer flip.
The DFlash decoder applies its non-unit value scale exactly once to query-path and cached-context values, which raises draft acceptance.
